about: Bedhead trunking modelled as a generic product: curved aluminium body with gas, power and ELV covers, uplight diffuser and lens, end caps, four sockets, three gas outlets, nurse-call and data outlets, light switch, bed number. The services are also hosted by the E/P families in the project (record note); the connectors here carry the casing's load and gas points. Bottom at z = 0; Default Elevation 1300. Body, covers, light and end caps per length; the 3000 type adds a second bed's outlets.
